notes.title: Need your help with idea!
notes.notes:
When a player captures a strategic tile (Keep, Mine, Farm or Sacred Site) there Kingdom's Flag is displayed! 

Currently, Team 1 is represented by the Blue Eagle, while Team 2 is represented by the Red Bear. I need logos for Team 3 and Team 4. I'm leaning toward a Green Wolf and a Gold Lion. But let me know your ideas!

Also, playing with the idea that each player can chose their own logo. Your color will be assigned at playtime, but could be a cool addition if each player can chose their own logo! 

So, I might need more than just 4 ideas, so give me some more!
